(COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPSS No.2392 of 2024
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Anil Anthwal, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Pradeep Hariya, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State.
3. Ms. Seema Sah, learned counsel for 
respondent no.4. 
4. Joint Secretary, Cooperative 
Societies join the proceedings through V.C. 
and informed to this Court that respondent 
no.3 is the only competent authority, who 
are under obligation to pay financial 
benefits arising out of 6th and 7th Pay 
Commission. The Government have no 
control over this committee, however, she 
submits that since District Assistant 
Registrar, Cooperative Societies is the 
Member Secretary of the said Committee, 
therefore, she can issue administrative 
direction to the District Assistant Registrar 
to do the needful in the matter being a 
Member Secretary of the said Committee.
5. Since the Member Secretary of the 
District Administration Committee is the 
District Assistant Registrar, therefore, 
learned Standing Counsel accepts notice 
on his behalf.
6. Put up this matter on 08.01.2025. 
7. On that day, State shall apprise to 
this Court what further action has been 
taken.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
19.12.2024

47 WPSS No. 2392 of 2024
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Anil Anthwal, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
 Mr. N.K. Papnoi, Brief Holder for the 
State/ respondent nos. 1 to 3.
Ms. Seema Sah, Advocate for the 
respondent no.4.
On 19.12.2024, State was required to 
apprise the Court with regard to the action 
that was to be undertaken pursuant to 
what had happened on that date.
Let State counsel has nothing to 
apprise the Court today.
The petitioner claims arrears of 5th, 
6th and 7th Pay Commissions with interest.
Heard.
Admit.
Learned C.S.C takes notice on behalf 
of the respondent nos. 1 to 3.
Ms. Seema Sah, Advocate taken 
notice on behalf of the respondent no.4.
Respondents may file counter 
affidavit within four weeks. Two weeks 
thereafter, rejoinder affidavit, if any, may 
be filed.
List thereafter for final hearing..
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
